Most weight settles through her straight left support leg; her right boot rests lightly on a low inspection curb with the knee relaxed, so hip and shoulder lines counter-tilt beneath a steady head. A readable triangular patch of continuous teal-lit background remains between her bent right forearm and waist. Hundreds of detached window bays form an impossible cresting wave overhead. Two opposed planar curves create one restrained S-route from that wave through the bowed plan edge into her coat hem. Wet concrete and runoff catch teal drainage light while amber roadway glow edges her and the window frames.

Photorealistic full-length environmental portrait: an original adult woman whose facial appearance follows the supplied reference image, while the character, body, wardrobe, and world remain original. Reference facial appearance stays stable in her natural turn. She is a cloud-forest storm-keeper performing a wind-calibration operation at violet predawn among rain-dark strangler-fig roots. Seen from a three-quarter rear view, she braces on a wet root catwalk, turns her face into view, and threads a luminous liana through a bronze tension ring to recalibrate a living storm compass. Fully closed opaque coat, trousers, gloves, and boots. Serpentine line of grace: a winding three-dimensional path travels from the spiral root catwalk through her turning coat and into the luminous liana; the contour orientation changes around the form from foreground root edge to side-and-back coat turn and forward-reaching vine; the path disappears behind and reappears beyond the bronze ring as the illuminated vine; drape highlight and shadow rotate together along wet nettle fiber, bronze, and vine tissue. Neutral waist-to-hip contour transition: a lateral waist hollow remains readable inside the restrained three-quarter rear working pose; the iliac crest to outer hip expansion forms a shallow continuous turn beneath the work coat; the outer hip continues into the outer thigh through the storm trousers; a declared three-quarter or side view conditions the contour under her braced working stance; body contour distinguished from garment compression; the fitted layers follow rather than invent the contour. Hourglass silhouette relation as neutral geometry: both side contours remain visible in a restrained three-quarter rear adult silhouette; the upper torso expands above the waist under the fully closed coat; a comparatively narrower natural waist is readable between upper torso and hips; the hips expand below the waist into the leg line; pose viewpoint and garment cinching declared separately; the loose belt follows the natural relation. Charged fog and first rain bend fern vanes; moss glow and one amber lamp reveal the hand-vine-ring mechanism.

Targeted repair: preserve the entire scene, stable facial appearance, three-quarter rear pose, hand-vine-ring interaction, winding depth path, weather, lighting, and materials from Image 1. Reframe slightly wider so both boots and feet sit fully inside the frame with margin. Let the fully opaque coat follow the natural back-to-waist and waist-to-hip transitions. The belt hangs visibly slack away from the waist; broad form light reveals a continuous contour across the fabric. Image 2 remains the facial-appearance reference only.

A miniature aurora crosses her waist; glacial-cyan reflections rise from the flooded floor and contour her face. Her structured black-and-copper observatory uniform is practical, fully clothed, close-collared. Render a neutral hourglass silhouette relation: the upper torso expands above the waist around a comparatively narrower natural waist, then the hips expand below the waist; smooth transitions, pose viewpoint and garment cinching declared separately, fabric following form. Preserve stable facial appearance indicated by the reference image. In a slight three-quarter facial crop with soft form light across the upper lip, model the philtral contour as two philtral columns around a central philtral groove descending into a double upper-lip arc. Eye-level 50 mm, natural skin, wet reflections, smoke glass, oxidized copper, restrained haze; prioritize the storm interaction and aurora boundary.
